children: This week, insider transactions were seen across heavyweights like Nvidia
and Tesla
. The following deals occurred between September 7 and September 11.
Nvidia

director Mark Stevens sold 1M shares in several transactions in the price range of $227 to $234 each for a total value of $235.64M. The sale accounted for about 3.42% of his holdings, leaving him with 30M shares.
Tesla
Chief Financial Officer Vaibhav Taneja sold 2,606 shares at $360.13 each for ~$938,419. The transaction represented about 1.87% of his holdings, leaving him with 136,972 shares.
Realty Income
director Gregory McLaughlin sold 3,475 shares at $60.15 each for around $209,022. The transaction represented about 9.10% of his holdings, leaving him with 34,732 shares.
Snowflake
director Mark Garrett sold 50,000 shares at $350 each for $17.5M. The sale accounted for about 27.61% of his holdings, leaving him with 131,084 shares.
Applied Materials
director Judy Bruner sold 1,000 shares at $465 each for $465,000. The transaction represented about 3.67% of her holdings, leaving her with 26,285 shares.
Two major transactions took place at Uber

this week. Chief Executive Officer Dara Khosrowshahi acquired 141,000 shares at $70.96 each for around $10.01M, while Chief Operating Officer Andrew Macdonald purchased a total of 70,000 shares for around $76 apiece for ~$5.31M. Their holdings increased to 1.37M and 426,320 shares, respectively.
GameStop
CEO Ryan Cohen purchased 1M shares at $20.38 each for around $20.38M, increasing his holdings to 39.35M shares.
Upstart Holdings
Chief Executive Officer Paul Gu purchased 50,000 shares at $25.55 each for about $1.28M, increasing his holdings to 1.35M shares.
Prospect Capital
Chief Executive Officer John Barry bought 1.22M shares at $2.24 each for ~$2.73M, bringing his total holdings to 90.93M shares.
